name: Film and safety capacitors
summary: Film and safety capacitors for AC lines, snubbers and timing: X2, Y, MKP and polyester types.
uses: Replacing an X2 capacitor in a power supply or appliance
Snubbers across relay and motor contacts
Timing and audio circuits that need stable values
identify: Rectangular yellow, grey or blue boxes, or orange dipped blobs, marked with a value such as 104 or 0.1 µF and a voltage, sometimes X2 or Y2. X2 types sit across the mains input of most appliances; big ones in induction hobs and inverters can hold a charge.
test: On the capacitance range, within about 10% of the label is good. Cracked or burnt bodies are dead; old X2 capacitors slowly lose value.

decay.note: Lasts. Old X2 capacitors slowly lose capacity.
